name: Image to SVG
task: Turn a picture into an SVG drawing
tagline: Trace a logo, icon or drawing into sharp, scalable shapes.
seoTitle: PNG and JPG to SVG converter without uploading
description: Turn a PNG, JPG, WebP, GIF or BMP picture into an SVG drawing for free, in your browser. Best for logos, icons and drawings. Your picture is never uploaded.

specs.Size: Pictures over 1200 px on the long side are shrunk to 1200 px before tracing
specs.Works offline: Yes, once the page has loaded

faq.a: No. The picture is traced inside this tab, and the page's security policy blocks it from sending data anywhere.

faq.q: Why does my photo look posterised?
faq.a: Tracing turns a picture into a few flat areas of colour. A logo or drawing already looks like that. A photo has millions of subtle shades, so it comes out as patches. Raise the colours and the detail for a closer match, but a photo will never look like a photo as an SVG.
Logo or icon for flat artwork with a few colours. Illustration for drawings with shading or many colours. Black and white for line art, signatures and stencils.
Yes. Open it in Inkscape, Figma, Illustrator or any vector editor. Each colour is a set of shapes you can move, recolour or delete. The tracer does not recognise letters, so text becomes shapes.
